scope: Real poster crop, exact original Facebook DINO conditioning, same pretrained occupancy flow and LoRA, all 4096 latent tokens, original 12 steps/22 forwards, all 60 self/cross modules use FP32 postscale exp/reciprocal attention with real-pair RoPE.

reference_cache.note: Stock FP32 trajectory reused after strict identity/hash checks; stored CPU duration describes the original computation, not this run.

finding: Real-poster latent error decreases from 0.7488 to 0.6074 vs FP32 and from 0.7174 to 0.5472 vs the CPU precision diagnostic. This costs 129.73s vs 88.12s for the original 22-forward sampler (47.2% longer). Single-forward error is 0.03324. Numerical gates remain failed; the process returncode 1 records those gates, not a native runtime crash.
decision: Retain opt-in as a precision/latency tradeoff, without production promotion or preserved-quality claims. Assess geometry using the common FP32 occupancy decoder in result041.
timing_scope: Resident weights and preuploaded conditions; input/output transfer, synchronized model calls, original CPU Euler/CFG arithmetic and instrumentation. Preparation, CPU reference, compilation/warmups and artifact I/O excluded.
